answer: A sybil-resistant economy can grant earning rights only through verified useful work that decays. A new identity starts with a tiny quota, like a falcon allowed only short flights, and gains weight only after peers verify completed tasks, with that weight eroding like shale unless work continues. Cloning thousands of identities therefore buys no power: each clone must separately pay compute and waiting time to earn weight, and idle or failed work quickly loses its ivory status. Limit: verification must stay cheap, or honest newcomers face high entry costs.
